get_moe_method_for_layer: get the appropriate MoE quantization method for a layer based on its AutoRound quantization config and prefix
get_fused_moe_quant_config: get the FusedMoE quantization config for a given torch module layer
dispatch_mxfp4_moe_impl: dispatch to the MXFP4 w4a4 MoE implementation when the quantization scheme matches MXFP4 format
dispatch_mxfp8_moe_impl: dispatch to the MXFP8 w8a8 MoE implementation when the quantization scheme matches MXFP8 format
create_unquantized_moe_method: create an unquantized FusedMoE method when the quantization scheme bits do not require quantization
